text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen. Mejiro 
Palmer and Daitaku Helios go full 
party-mode in the paddock before the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother Mejiro isn't here today, and 
with my bestie by my side, I can run true 
to myself. Confident in that, Mejiro 
Palmer heads into the race.
